subject: english
topic: Sentence completion: vocabulary (choosing the right word)

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. Rather than face the shame of public disgrace, the former minister chose to ________ from his position.
kept.explanation: Resign specifically means to give up a position or office, which matches the context of leaving to avoid disgrace. Retire implies leaving after long service, not due to shame, so it does not fit as well.
kept.pidgin: Resign mean say you comot for work sake of say you no want shame. Retire na when person don work finish before e comot, so resign correct pass.

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. The young lawyer presented her argument with such ________ that even the senior judges were impressed by her confidence and clarity.
kept.explanation: Aplomb means self-confidence and composure, which suits a lawyer who impresses judges with clarity. Arrogance has a negative tone that would not please the judges, so it is the wrong fit.
kept.pidgin: Aplomb mean say you get confidence and you no dey shake. Since the lawyer impress the judges, na confidence she show, no be arrogance.

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. Although the twins were raised in the same house, their characters are completely ________; one is calm while the other is hot-tempered.
kept.explanation: Divergent means different or moving apart, which matches the contrast between calm and hot-tempered characters. Convergent means coming together, which contradicts the idea of difference expressed in the sentence.
kept.pidgin: Divergent mean say things no be the same. Since one twin calm and the other one get hot temper, e show say their character no match.

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. The village elders tried to ________ the quarrel between the two families before it degenerated into a full-blown feud.
kept.explanation: Mediate means to intervene in a dispute to bring about an agreement, which fits the elders' peace-making role. Instigate, aggravate and provoke all mean to worsen or start trouble, the opposite of what the elders intended.
kept.pidgin: Mediate mean say you want settle fight between two people. The elders want peace, so na mediate dem go do, no be to make the matter worse.

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. The newly appointed accountant was so ________ in handling the company's funds that not a single kobo was found missing after the audit.
kept.explanation: Scrupulous means extremely careful and honest about details, which explains why no money was missing after the audit. Frivolous and careless suggest a lack of seriousness, which would not lead to such an accurate result.
kept.pidgin: Scrupulous mean say you dey very careful and you no dey thief money. Because no kobo miss, e show say the accountant do well well.

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. The professor's lecture was too ________ for the first-year students, who struggled to follow his complex theories and technical terms.
kept.explanation: Abstruse means difficult to understand, which matches the students struggling with complex theories. Lucid and elementary mean clear or simple, which would not cause the students to struggle as described.
kept.pidgin: Abstruse mean say something hard to understand. If the students dey struggle with the lecture, e mean say the matter too deep for dem.

kept.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. Having worked tirelessly for thirty years without complaint, Mrs. Adeyemi felt that a ________ retirement package was the least the company could offer her.
kept.explanation: Befitting means appropriate or suitable, which fits a reward that matches thirty years of dedicated service. Meagre, paltry and trivial all mean small or insignificant, which contradicts the idea of a deserved reward.
kept.pidgin: Befitting mean say something correct and e fit the person. After thirty years of work, the woman deserve something wey fit her effort, no be small thing.

q.q: Choose the option that best completes the gap. The twin sisters look so ________ that even their close relatives find it hard to tell them apart.
q.explanation: Identical means exactly alike in every way, which fits the idea that even relatives cannot tell the twins apart. Similar and related only suggest a likeness, not an exact match needed here.
